mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mvcboard2 (bname, bpass, btitle, bcontent, bip, bfile) VALUES (#{bname}, #{bpass}, #{btitle}, #{bcontent}, #{bip}, #{bfile});
mapper.update: update mvcboard2 set btitle=#{btitle} , bcontent=#{bcontent}, bfile=#{bfile} where bno= #{bno} and bpass=#{bpass}
update mvcboard2 set bhit = bhit + 1 where bno = #{bno}
mapper.delete: delete from mvcboard2 where bno= #{bno} and bpass=#{bpass}
mapper.select: select * from mvcboard2 order by bno desc ;
select * from mvcboard2 order by bno desc limit #{start}, #{end}
